profile.registerNotes: Use 해요체 (polite informal) with the candidate; 합쇼체 (-습니다) in formal role-plays (officials, briefings). 반말 only between close friends in a role-play.

2: a current event in your country
2+: advantages and disadvantages of a policy
a problem in your community and its causes
3: supporting an opinion on an abstract issue
hypothetical: what if your country changed a major policy
the role of technology in society

rolePlaySeeds: Check into a hotel and solve a problem with the reservation (interviewer: receptionist).
Buy a train ticket after the train you wanted was cancelled (interviewer: ticket agent).
Report a lost passport at a police station (interviewer: police officer).
Arrange a meeting time with a colleague whose schedule keeps changing (interviewer: colleague).
Persuade a landlord to fix a broken heater before winter (interviewer: landlord).
Brief a local official about a joint exercise that will close a road (interviewer: town official).
Explain a misunderstanding between two delegations as their interpreter (interviewer: delegation leader).
At a checkpoint, explain why your convoy must pass before noon (interviewer: checkpoint officer).

rolePlays.situation: You are at a hotel and need to check in. The hotel has your reservation, but there is no room available due to an error.
rolePlays.opening: 안녕하세요. 어떤 도움을 드릴까요?

rolePlays.situation: You need to buy a train ticket, but the train you wanted to take has been cancelled.
rolePlays.opening: 안녕하세요. 티켓을 사고 싶으신가요?

rolePlays.situation: You need to report a lost passport to the police.

rolePlays.situation: You need to arrange a meeting time with a colleague, but their schedule keeps changing.

rolePlays.situation: You are a military liaison. Brief a local official about a joint exercise that will close a main road for several hours. The official is concerned about traffic delays.
rolePlays.opening: 안녕하세요, 마을의 주요 도로를 일시적으로 폐쇄해야 하는 상황에 대해 말씀드리기 위해 왔습니다.

rolePlays.situation: You are at a checkpoint and need to pass your convoy before noon. Explain the urgency to the checkpoint officer.
rolePlays.opening: 안녕하세요, 우리 차량 단은 정오 전에 통과해야 합니다. 시간이 중요합니다.
rolePlays.english: Good morning, our convoy must pass before noon. Time is of the essence.

rolePlays.situation: You are acting as an interpreter for two delegations that are having a misunderstanding. Explain the situation to the delegation leader.
rolePlays.opening: 안녕하세요, 두 대표단 사이에 오해가 있습니다. 제가 상황을 설명드리겠습니다.

rolePlays.situation: You are a tenant trying to persuade your landlord to fix a broken heater before winter. The landlord is reluctant to spend money on repairs.
rolePlays.opening: 안녕하세요, 겨울이 오기 전에 고장 난 난방을 고쳐야 합니다. 추운 날씨가 올거라는 걸 알고 계시죠?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a restaurant with a close friend. You both ordered food, but the waiter brought the wrong dishes. Explain the mistake to the waiter and ask for the correct order.

rolePlays.situation: You are at a hospital and need to explain your symptoms to a doctor. The doctor is busy and you have to be concise.

rolePlays.situation: You are a soldier. You need to report to your superior officer that your unit's equipment is damaged and needs repair.

rolePlays.situation: You are at a university and need to ask a professor for an extension on a paper due to personal reasons.
rolePlays.opening: 안녕하세요, 교수님. 제출 기한을 연장해 주실 수 있나요? 개인적인 사정으로 과제를 마무리하지 못했어요.
rolePlays.english: Hello Professor. Can you extend the submission deadline? I haven't been able to finish my assignment due to personal reasons.

0+: I can greet people and say my name.
I can give numbers, prices, days and times.
I can answer very simple questions with memorized phrases.
1: I can make simple sentences about myself, my family and my daily routine.
I can ask and answer simple questions about familiar topics.
I can handle basic needs: ordering food, buying a ticket, asking for directions.
1+: I can describe places and people in connected sentences.
I can tell what happened on a recent trip or weekend.
I can handle routine situations even when something small goes wrong.
2: I can narrate past, present and future events in paragraphs.
I can describe and explain concrete topics at work and in the news.
I can resolve a complication in a role-play, like a cancelled reservation.
